QuestInfo.name: [Heliseum] Shadows of Grandis
QuestInfo.0: #bEdea#k at the #bHeliseum Reclamation HQ#k is looking into restoring the Blue Dragon Cannon. Talk to Edea.
QuestInfo.1:
Many materials are required to restore the Blue Dragon Cannon. The #bamplifier#k in particular must to be obtained elsewhere... Edea said they have no choice but to do business with the Shadowdealers. 

Go to the #bMerchant Meet-Up#k and #buse the transmitter#k to call the Shadowdealers. 


#r#e*If you fail, forfeit the quest and start over from the beginning.#k
QuestInfo.2: You contacted #bTonero#k of the Shadowdealers at the Merchant Meet-Up.
